offering_description.value: Provides IP and optical networking equipment and cloud-native communications software to telecom service providers, enterprises and governments. Products include session border controllers, voice core software, routers and optical transport, plus security and analytics. Delivered as software and hardware with support and professional services.

primary_products.value: session border controllers; cloud voice core and call routing software; IP routing equipment; optical transport systems; network analytics and security software

primary_services.value: technical support and maintenance; professional services and network deployment; managed cloud communications

customer_segment.value: B2B: telecom service providers, cable operators and large enterprises; B2G: government and defense agencies

end_markets.value: telecommunications; enterprise communications; government and defense; utilities and critical infrastructure

revenue_model.value: product sales: hardware and perpetual software licenses; subscription: cloud and software-as-a-service communications offerings; service fees: support, maintenance and professional services

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: designs networking hardware built by contract manufacturers, sold to carriers and enterprises; software / platform: develops communications and security software sold to service providers

geography_served.value: global: United States, Europe, Middle East, Africa, Asia-Pacific and Latin America

specialization.value: related lines: cloud and edge communications software plus IP and optical networking

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales to large carriers and enterprises; partners / resellers: channel partners, resellers and system integrators

regulatory_exposure.value: low: Normal business rules, export controls and telecom standards apply, with government security requirements for some sales
